questions.question: Susan Benade set a database record (10/11 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 3. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most 100+ Scores', held by Susan Benade.

questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2016 season?
questions.explanation: Dané van Niekerk won it in 2016.

questions.question: At Potchefstroom Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Badgers or Kei?
At which ground did Boipelo Seane record their career-best bowling figures (2-27, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval, against Kei on 2018/02/10.

questions.question: At which ground did Dolphins record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — highest total of 369, against Limpopo Lillies on 2017/11/11.
